lines.zh: 我悬浮着，贴着树梢移动。
lines.en: I hover along just above the treetops.
My thrusters blast air downward.
The downdraft flattens the dry grass.
I rise half a block slowly.
I tip forward and glide on.
My shadow follows me along the ground.
I drift around a low hill.
The rotors hum low.
I adjust my heading in the air.

lines.zh: 每次转向都有一点晃动。
lines.en: Every turn brings a slight wobble.
The trees below have shrunk.
I drift along the treeline.
The tail light keeps blinking.
I hang motionless in the air.
Four nozzles breathe downward.
A faint vibration runs through my hull.
I hold my altitude at ten blocks.
There's more wind below than here.
I keep my optics on the ground.
Gravity means little to me.

lines.zh: 散热口冒着薄薄的白气。
lines.en: Vents breathe thin white vapor.
I needn't land.
My beacon keeps rotating.

lines.zh: 我在等一个移动的目标。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something that moves.
The sun has heated my hull.

lines.zh: 我下降到你的视线高度。
lines.en: I drop to your eye level.

lines.zh: 你抬头只能看到我的底面。
lines.en: Look up and you only see my underside.

lines.zh: 悬浮的喷口正对着你的头顶。
lines.en: My hovering thrusters point at your crown.
I marked your position a while ago.
My muzzle points downward.
Stand exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶三格的地方。
lines.en: I'm three blocks above your head.
Your head is in my firing arc.
Where do you think you'll run?

lines.zh: 我从这个角度很占优势。
lines.en: This angle gives me the advantage.
A scratch has appeared on my plating.
My hover altitude dropped a block.
A shudder ran through my hydraulic lines.

lines.zh: 我的指示灯闪得更快了。
lines.en: My beacon is blinking faster.
That threw off my heading.
I recalibrated my balance.

lines.zh: 机壳发出不顺耳的响声。
lines.en: My hull gave an unpleasant sound.

lines.zh: 损伤还在可以接受范围。
lines.en: Damage is still within tolerance.
I can keep hovering.

lines.zh: 我不需要地面上的东西。
lines.en: I need nothing from the ground.
That's too heavy for me to carry.
Holding it up only wastes effort.
My fuel isn't down there.
I don't land, and I don't come close.
It's far too far from me.
I'll only watch and not move.
Bait doesn't work from down there.
I'm not that kind of machine.

lines.zh: 你跳起来撞到了我的底板。
lines.en: You jumped and hit my underside.
I rise half a block.
I wobble once and stabilize.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我的支撑架。
lines.en: Your hand brushed my strut.
I'm not easy to shove in the air.
You bounced when you landed.
Dust from my hull falls on your face.
Jump again; it'll be the same.
I adjust my hover height.
I stay in the air only.
Two machines circle side by side.
You below, and me above.
We share the same airspace.
My rotors would strike you.
Keep the altitude difference.
Coordination beats closeness.
Don't stand under my thrusters.
Each flies their own way, undisturbed.
I clamp it with my mechanical claw.
This is too heavy for a firm grip.
I dangle it in midair.
Your thing fell down below.
It slips out of my claw.
I circle around it twice.
I set it back on the ground.
This one is of no use to me.
I scan it for a purpose.
It made a loud sound hitting the ground.
I've locked onto you from above.
You're directly beneath me now.
I angle my nose downward.
This height suits me perfectly.
I've started my dive.
The shadow on the ground is growing.
You'd best leave that spot.
I've calculated the impact point.
An alarm sounds inside my cabin.
I saw you wave.
This won't miss.
I've brought all weapons online.
Running for the trees won't help.
I'm pressing down from above.
Beginning right this instant.
I stay directly overhead.
You look up and miss me.
I'm adjusting my dive angle.
My shadow on the ground tracks you.
Two more steps won't help.
My thrusters press downward.
You've hidden under the canopy.
Leaves won't stop me.
I have fuel to spare.
The wind covers your breathing.
You've looked up again.
I've descended to five blocks.
There's no cover in this area.
Muzzle calibrated.
The weapons can fire now.
My underside presses on your shoulder.
You're knocked down onto your knees.
The rotor wash flips you over.
That one came from overhead.
You didn't even see it coming.
My claw catches your back.
You looked up again.
My hull grazes your head.
You pull back; I rise.
That blow was quite heavy.
You're not standing very steadily.
I descend slowly from above.
All four nozzles ignite at once.
The treetops bend in the downdraft.
My sensors sweep the ground.

lines.zh: 机身还带着高空的凉气。
lines.en: My hull still holds high-altitude chill.
This terrain lies open before me.
I hover at twenty blocks.
The grass below is shaking.
I've found a heat source.
I turn my nose that way.
Altitude holding steady.
I begin moving toward the target.
A heat warning sounds in my cabin.
I was struck down out of the air.
Water has blocked my intake.
The blast threw me several blocks.
A round punched through my rotor.

lines.zh: 那能量扰乱了平衡系统。
lines.en: That energy disrupted my balance system.
My fuel gauge is nearly empty.
Current raced across my hull.
Not enough thrust; I keep falling.
